style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 60cm Pre Lit Christmas Conifer & Pinecone Outdoor Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Are you ready to celebrate the season in style with this gorgeous wreath? The 60cm Pre Lit Christmas Conifer & Pinecone Outdoor Wreath gets your home in the mood for the holidays. The simple refreshing faux foliage wreath is amply sized and dotted with 50 LED lights. Low maintenance, just pop it on your door and let the festivities begin. The LED lights create a gentle uplifting aura on those long winter nights. Bring the twinkles of the sky to your front door, for inspiration at eye-level. The conifer and pinecone wreath goes great over natural doors, as well as balancing with more elaborate entrances. Set it high and let the lights come on nightly with the optional 6-hour timer, which will turn the LEDs on without you having to lift a finger, and then switch them off again. There’s also a constant ‘on’ mode. Dimensions(mm): Height: 600. Width: 600. Depth: 150.
